contrast: within each of five seasons: mean(Niijima,Kozu,Miyake,Hachijo) minus Oshima
reading: Community corrected trait matching is lower post-Oshima in four of five seasons and has a negative mean contrast. Pollinator and plant functional generality do not share that direction and are often higher post-Oshima. Pollinator richness is lower in four of five seasons. The contemporary community pattern is therefore channel-specific rather than a synchronous network collapse.
claim_boundary: Five seasons estimate temporal consistency for the same sites; they are not five independent geographic boundary replications. Oshima remains the only bridge-state site, so these are descriptive network contrasts and cannot identify a causal second-boundary effect.
